subScenes.name: 进店询问
subScenes.description: 顾客进店，向店员询问是否有运动鞋。

qaPairs.triggerText: What are you looking for today?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 今天您想找什么样的鞋？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 店员主动询问顾客需求，开启购鞋对话

followUps.text: I need running shoes for marathon training.
followUps.text_cn: 我需要一双马拉松训练用的跑鞋。

followUps.text: I'm looking for something formal for a wedding.
followUps.text_cn: 我在找一双参加婚礼的正装鞋。

followUps.text: Just browsing, but I might need comfort shoes for work.
followUps.text_cn: 我只是看看，不过可能需要一双上班穿的舒适鞋。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于店员开场询问时，顾客根据不同目的做出回应，体现真实购鞋动机差异

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have these in size 9?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客选定款式后询问尺码库存，关键购买环节

followUps.text: Yes, we have them in stock. Would you like to try them on?
followUps.text_cn: 有的，我们有货。要试穿一下吗？

followUps.text: Sorry, size 9 is sold out. We can order it for you.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，9码卖完了，我们可以为您订货。

followUps.text: We only have size 8 and 10. Would you consider one of those?
followUps.text_cn: 我们只有8码和10码，您能考虑其中一个吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客询问尺码时，店员根据不同库存情况做出三种典型回应，覆盖常见购鞋障碍

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客确认价格后决定是否购买，关键决策点

followUps.text: They're $120. We're currently offering a 20% discount.
followUps.text_cn: 120美元，目前有20%的折扣。

followUps.text: That's $150, but I can give you $10 off if you buy today.
followUps.text_cn: 原价150美元，如果您今天购买，我可以给您减10美元。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, those are non-negotiable. They're on clearance already.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，这个价格不能谈了，已经是最清仓价了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客问价时，店员根据库存策略、促销政策和议价空间给出三种典型回应，反映真实销售情境

subScenes.name: 确认尺码
subScenes.description: 店员询问并确认顾客的鞋码大小。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 确认尺码：服务员询问用户常规尺码

followUps.text: I usually wear a size 9 in men's shoes.
followUps.text_cn: 我平时穿男款9码。

followUps.text: I'm not sure—I think it's 8.5, but I need to try them on.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，可能是8.5，但我得试穿一下。

followUps.text: I wear a 7.5 in women’s, but I buy men’s for comfort—do you have those?
followUps.text_cn: 我穿女款7.5，但为了舒适会买男款，你们有男款吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于确认用户常规鞋码，是试穿前的标准流程，适用于所有鞋类购买场景。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you usually go for a snug fit or a bit more room?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您平时喜欢合脚一点，还是稍微宽松一点？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 确认尺码：服务员询问穿着偏好

followUps.text: I prefer a snug fit—I hate when shoes slide at the heel.
followUps.text_cn: 我喜欢合脚的，不喜欢脚后跟滑动。

followUps.text: I like extra room, especially for walking all day.
followUps.text_cn: 我喜欢宽松一点，特别是整天走路的时候。

followUps.text: It depends on the style—tight for dress shoes, loose for sneakers.
followUps.text_cn: 这要看款式，正装鞋要紧，运动鞋要松。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于判断用户对鞋型贴合度的偏好，帮助推荐合适鞋款，常见于中高端鞋店。

qaPairs.triggerText: Have you worn this brand before? Their sizing runs a bit small.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您以前穿过这个品牌吗？他们的尺码偏小。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 确认尺码：服务员提示品牌尺码特性

followUps.text: Yes, I bought these last year—I’ll take a half size up.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，我去年买过这款，这次我选大半码。

followUps.text: No, I’ve never tried them—should I go up a full size then?
followUps.text_cn: 没穿过，那我该选大一整码吗？

followUps.text: I’ll just try both sizes—can I get a 7.5 and an 8?
followUps.text_cn: 我还是两个码都试一下吧，能给我拿7.5和8吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于应对品牌尺码偏差，是专业鞋店常见服务环节，帮助用户避免买错。

subScenes.name: 试穿鞋子
subScenes.description: 顾客试穿几双鞋，反馈舒适度。

qaPairs.triggerText: How does this pair feel on your feet?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 这双鞋穿起来感觉怎么样？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 试穿鞋子后，店员询问舒适度

followUps.text: They're a bit tight in the toes—I need a half size up.
followUps.text_cn: 脚趾有点紧，我得换大半码。

followUps.text: Perfect! I'll take them.
followUps.text_cn: 太合适了！我就买这双。

followUps.text: Can I try another style? These feel a little slippery.
followUps.text_cn: 我可以试试别的款式吗？这双有点滑。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于试穿后反馈舒适度，是购鞋流程中最关键的互动环节之一

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you want to try them with the insoles we offer?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您要试试我们提供的鞋垫吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 店员建议使用附加鞋垫提升舒适度

followUps.text: Yes, please—I have flat feet and need extra support.
followUps.text_cn: 请给我一个，我扁平足，需要额外支撑。

followUps.text: No thanks, I'm good without them.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，我觉得不加也行。

followUps.text: Do you have memory foam ones? I heard they're better for walking.
followUps.text_cn: 你们有记忆棉的吗？我听说走路时更舒服。

qaPairs.usageNote: 店员常主动提供鞋垫选项，用户回应体现个性化需求或经济考量

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like to walk around the store to test them out?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您要不要在店里走几步试试？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 店员建议在店内走动测试鞋子的实用性

followUps.text: Yes, I'll walk to the back and back.
followUps.text_cn: 好，我走到店后面再走回来。

followUps.text: I'm in a hurry—can I just stand and move my feet a bit?
followUps.text_cn: 我赶时间，能只站着动动脚吗？

followUps.text: Actually, I'll take them home and try them on my commute.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我想带回家，试试上下班穿的感觉。

qaPairs.usageNote: 店员引导试穿动作，用户回应反映其购买决策风格和时间压力

subScenes.name: 询问价格
subScenes.description: 顾客询问选定鞋子的价格和折扣。

qaPairs.triggerText: How much do these shoes cost?

followUps.text: They're $89.99.
They're on sale for $69.99 today — originally $99.
followUps.text_cn: 今天特价69.99美元，原价99美元。

followUps.text: That pair is $99, but if you buy two, the second one is 50% off.
followUps.text_cn: 这双99美元，但如果买两双，第二双半价。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客询问价格时，店员可能根据库存、促销或组合销售给出不同回应，学习者需理解价格背后的销售策略。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 顾客确认价格是否可议

followUps.text: Yes, this is our best price — it's already discounted.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，这是我们的最低价了，已经打折了。

followUps.text: I can give you $5 off if you take them today.
followUps.text_cn: 如果你今天买，我可以再减5美元。

followUps.text: I'll check with my manager — give me one minute.
followUps.text_cn: 我得去问问经理，等我一分钟。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客试探价格底线时，店员回应体现灵活性、规则或流程，学习者需掌握不同回应背后的销售心理。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have any cheaper options?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你们有更便宜的选择吗？

followUps.text: We have these basic sneakers for $39.99 — same brand, simpler design.
followUps.text_cn: 我们有这款基础运动鞋，39.99美元——同品牌，设计更简单。

followUps.text: Not in this store, but our outlet location has clearance items under $30.
followUps.text_cn: 这家店没有，但我们的折扣店有低于30美元的清仓商品。

followUps.text: I'm sorry, all our shoes are quality-made — we don't carry budget lines.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉，我们所有鞋子都是高品质制作，不卖低价系列。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客寻求性价比时，店员可能提供替代品、转介绍或坚持品牌定位，学习者需适应不同销售策略下的回应。

subScenes.name: 付款结账
subScenes.description: 顾客确认付款方式并完成购买。

qaPairs.triggerText: How would you like to pay?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 鞋店结账时收银员询问支付方式

followUps.text: I'll pay by card, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我刷卡，谢谢。

followUps.text: Do you accept cash? I only have bills today.
followUps.text_cn: 你们收现金吗？我今天只带了现金。

followUps.text: Can I use Apple Pay? My card’s not working.
followUps.text_cn: 能用Apple Pay吗？我的卡刷不了了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 结账时最常见的支付方式询问，顾客需根据自身情况选择支付手段，回应应简洁明确。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 收银员告知总价后，顾客的反应

followUps.text: Here you go, and can I get a receipt?
followUps.text_cn: 给你钱，能给我一张收据吗？

followUps.text: Oh, I was expecting it to be cheaper… Do you have any discounts?
followUps.text_cn: 啊，我以为会更便宜……你们有折扣吗？

followUps.text: I’ll take it. Just put it in a bag, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我买了，麻烦装进袋子里。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客听到总价后的典型反应，可能涉及收据、议价或直接成交，需灵活应对不同心理状态。

qaPairs.triggerText: Did you find everything you needed today?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 今天您找到需要的东西了吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 结账前服务员确认购物体验，为结账铺垫

followUps.text: Yes, these shoes are perfect! Thanks for your help.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，这双鞋太合适了！谢谢你的帮助。

followUps.text: I found them, but I’m not sure about the size. Can I exchange later?
followUps.text_cn: 我找到了，但不确定尺码对不对，能以后换吗？

followUps.text: Actually, I’m still looking at the other pair. Can I come back in 10 minutes?
followUps.text_cn: 其实我还在看另一双，能等我10分钟再回来结账吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 服务员常在结账前确认顾客满意度，顾客回应可能体现满意、犹豫或需要时间决策，是自然对话的关键节点。
